course_name: 進階專業英文-設計與人文(一)
outline:
本課程提供學生及職前專業人士必備之英語文語言技巧，強調設計與人文專業領域之英文溝通能力之訓練。課程內容依學院專業內容區分並整合英語文之聽說讀寫之能力為未來全球化移動及以英語專業溝通人才培育為目標。
This course aims to provide pre-service design and cultural business students/professionals with the adequate skills of the English language and communicative competence to facilitate their current academic and future career pursuits. Students are encouraged to utilize their domain expertise to participate in professional communication in English. Centered on the training of professional use of the English language, the ESP curriculum as the crux of a highly-integrated work of domain knowledge and the English learning development embodies the indispensable credentials required for a global profession.

category: 學生分組實作及討論(Student group practice and discussion)
flexible_learning.content: Students will be put into groups and present online assigned reading materials. Each student is responsible for a task in relation to the vocabulary items and phrases, a skill, and the reading passage itself. Interactive comprehension questions will take place to facilitate learning. Students are encouraged to make use of a PPT and any other outside sources. In the end the instructor will give each group feedback and this activity aims to aid discussion and positive results among students.
flexible_learning.outcome: This activity (online synchronous distance learning) aims to encourage self-study among students. Students are requested to work on their individual reading passage and prepare in advance. Students work in teams with different roles. The skills they acquire in the main text of this course facilitate comprehension of the materials for this activity. The outcomes of this activity is therefore positive.
flexible_learning.assessment_ratio: The rating criteria will be 20~25% of the term grade. The main assessment categories are pronunciation, fluency, and content.
